newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with hardly enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, few sales $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand generally light. Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter steers and 900 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 93,700 head confirmed including 18,900 head or about 20 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1175 lbs 68.00, few Select with end Choice 1200 lb cutting bulls 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000 lbs 68.00.
confirmed - 1,500 week ago - none year ago - 1,900
Wk to date - 93,700 week ago - 87,900 year ago - 49,800
